pr_title: GDScript: Preload should make native type
pr_body:
`reduce_preload()` was calling `type_from_variant()` which made datatype with `kind` set to `BUILTIN`, not `NATIVE`
`type_from_variant()` now returns a variant type when passed a null value, fixes #61159
pr_comments: The CI build failure is unrelated, it's a temporary inconsistency between godot and godot-cpp, which should be fixed when #67751 is merged. (So you'll have to rebase then.)

issue_context.title: Incorrect GDScript warning emitted at assigning a null result from a function
issue_context.body: ### Godot version 838cb598e3ef5572018d3d549c15bb27b0a5864d ### System information Windows 11 ### Issue description The following code will generate an incorrect warning at project run: ``` extends Node func get_param(): return null func _ready(): var test = get_param() print(test) ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3036176/169095669-46e2981a-f0b4-49d9-8a51-644fd00d2c30.png) The returning a `null` from a function is absolutely correct, and the result may be assigned to a variable just like a common type. Does not happen on 3.x, so this is a regression ### Steps to reproduce Create a function which return null and try to assign the result of it to a variable ### Minimal reproduction project [AssignmentWarningBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8718288/AssignmentWarningBug.zip)

review_comments: Is this always true? I don't know what `p_value` represents here exactly but in PropertyInfo, there's `PROPERTY_USAGE_NIL_IS_VARIANT` for the case where `Variant::NIL` should be handled as `Variant()`. Otherwise it's indeed `void`.

this function is for when the analyzer is given a variant and needs to make a corresponding datatype.
as far as i know, void is only used in specific places and is never inferred from a value (only by name and lack of value)
in all the places this function is used, i wouldn't expect void to ever be returned.
the return type of `get_param()` in that code snippet would be `void`, because there's no null literal to pass to `type_from_variant`
determined here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/daf168f4c821980a6a06fde67057f6a14d9e20c6/modules/gdscript/gdscript_analyzer.cpp#L1781-L1785
